<!-- pr-reviewer: 6251e540aac6912a41edbaed9136960c2c06f102 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one layout overlap to fix. Everything else is in good shape.

### What looks good
- The move keeps behaviour. `viewport_bar::act` is the old `viewcube::act` line for line (Frame queues `frame_all`, Iso calls `view_iso`, and Wire, Paths and Axes write view state as before). The five glyphs are painted by the same code. All five buttons (Frame, Iso, Wire, Paths, Axes) are still there in `NAVS` order. They had no accessible names or tooltips before (painted, not widgets), and they still have none, so nothing was lost there.
- `Hud::contains` now covers the whole ribbon (`viewcube.rs:111-113`), so a press in the padding between buttons is taken by the furniture and does not orbit or pick through it. That is right.
- The rewritten layout test is not weaker than the one it replaced. The old test checked: cube position, column inside the pane, column ending above the pane bottom, first button under the cube, and the 120 / 250-high / 130 gates. The new test keeps the cube and gate checks. It also checks the ribbon is centred, rests 10 px off the bottom, does not touch the cube, and holds all five buttons. It adds a new 170 px "too narrow" case. `bar_fits_its_buttons` pins `BAR_W` against the button arithmetic.
- The narrow-pane trade (panes about 128-178 px wide lose the cube and the buttons) is announced in the PR body and in `docs/decisions/1198-viewport-overlay-bar.md`, and pinned by the 170/180 asserts. A pane that narrow is not a working viewport, so this is acceptable.
- Layering is clean: the new module imports only `crate::actions` and `crate::state`, with no Flecs or app world calls. There are no new components. `viewcube.rs` drops from 459 to 313 lines, and the new file is 222. The provenance line is present. There is no unwrap/expect/panic outside tests. `hex[k]` indexes a 6-element Vec with k in {0,2,4}, the same as before.
- No snapshot PNG, golden, process file, build.rs, `.github` or dependency is touched.

### Local results (head 6251e540, already contains origin/main 62a2c93 - trial merge was a no-op)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | plan: ui lib + `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `theme_files` |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | ok - 594 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| incl. `the_hud_is_laid_out_from_the_pane_alone`, `bar_fits_its_buttons`, `the_nav_bar_drives_view_state`, `view_cube_face_click_orients_and_arms_nothing` + other view cube laws | ok - 12/12 |
| `--test boundary` | ok - 3 passed |
| `--test boundary_picks` | ok - 6 passed |
| `--test theme_files` | ok - 14 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
1. **The ribbon paints over the control hint on ordinary pane widths.** The hint is drawn bottom-right at `resp.rect.max - (12, 12)`, `RIGHT_BOTTOM`-aligned (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:737-743`). It is the ~62-character "LMB pick / drag-orbit · MMB orbit · RMB pan · wheel · F frame" in the Small font, which is roughly 300 px wide at egui's default 9 px. The ribbon is 158 x 38 px, centred, from `bottom-48` to `bottom-10` (`viewport_bar.rs:48-51`). Its band covers the hint's line, and the ribbon is painted after the hint (`shell.rs:747-753`). So once the pane is narrower than about 2 x (12 + 300 + 79), roughly 780 px, the translucent ribbon sits on the left part of the legend whenever the pointer is in the viewport. A docked viewport on a 1366-wide laptop, or beside the browser and an op panel, is in that range. The decision file says "the centred ribbon will sit clear of it on normal pane widths". That holds only for wide panes. Fix: lift the hint above the ribbon, e.g. anchor it at `rect.max.y - (BAR_H + 2 * margin)`, or only when its galley would intersect `bar_rect`. Or move the ribbon or the hint so they cannot share the band. Pin the fix with a test that lays out the hint galley for a narrow pane (say 700 px) and asserts `!bar.intersects(hint_rect)`.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The empty-document line "No model yet - File > Model ..." is centred at `bottom - 56` (`shell.rs:722-728`), which puts its lower edge about 2-3 px above the ribbon's top (`bottom - 48`) at the Small x 1.2 size. It clears, but only just; a larger UI font would touch. Worth adding the ribbon's height to that offset while you are in the area.
- The cube is dropped together with the ribbon on 128-178 px panes. You could keep the cube alone in that range and gate only the ribbon on `BAR_W` (`Hud` with an optional bar). Your call, and fine to leave as decided.
- Screen-projected overlays (#645 gizmo/origin labels, plate labels) can pass under the ribbon now, the same way they could under the old column. That is expected for fixed furniture and is not a regression.
- Nothing was seen on screen (as the PR says): the alpha-160 ribbon's contrast on the light ground is unverified. The hand test should look at both grounds.
- `law_tests.rs` is 2332 lines (already far over ~400). This PR adds only 2 net lines. Noted only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fdcfff5bd353a72567259c2f6efd946ee031c2d4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** It is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut. My earlier blocker is fixed, and the #1204 port is faithful.

### What looks good
- **Blocker fixed (`57c67557`).** The ribbon now sits at the bottom-left (`viewport_bar.rs` `bar_rect`: x from `pane.min.x + 10`, y from `bottom-48` to `bottom-10`). The legend keeps the bottom-right, anchored through the shared `LEGEND` / `legend_anchor`, which the shell now uses (`shell.rs:734,738`), so the test measures the same string at the same anchor. My own arithmetic matches the author's: the ribbon spans x 10..198, and the legend spans `w-254.75 .. w-12` (242.75 px at the Small style). The two meet only when the pane is narrower than about 453 px. `legend_clears_the_ribbon` pins 700x600 and 1600x900, using the font-measured width rather than a guess. There is nothing else fixed at the bottom-left of the pane: only scene-projected labels can pass under it, as before.
- **#1204 port (`fdcfff5b`, the conflict in `viewcube.rs`).** `git show --remerge-diff` shows main's side was dropped in `viewcube.rs` and moved into `viewport_bar.rs` unchanged: the `PickThrough` variant with its doc, the six-entry `NAVS` (now `[Nav; NAV_COUNT]`), `pick_through_label` with the same strings, the act arm (toggles `state.pick_through` and sets the status line), the active state `state.pick_through`, and the ray-through-bar glyph, line for line. It is still off by default (`state.rs:1845`, untouched). The bar's act arm (`viewport_bar.rs:117`) is still the only place that writes `pick_through`. `egui_app/tests/pick_through.rs` is identical to main (empty diff), and all four of its tests pass.
- **Layout tests.** `bar_fits_its_buttons` now derives the width from `NAVS.len()`, checks `NAV_COUNT` against it, and checks the last button is `NAVS.last()` and lies inside the bar. `the_hud_is_laid_out_from_the_pane_alone` checks every `NAVS` entry sits in the bar, the bar hugs the left and bottom edges and never meets the cube, and the size gate at `min_width()` / `min_width() - 1`.
- **Housekeeping.** `viewcube.rs` is 321 lines and `viewport_bar.rs` is 308, both under ~400. The new module has its provenance line. Layering is clean: the module imports only `crate::actions` and `crate::state`, with no app world or Flecs calls. No snapshot PNG, golden, process file, build.rs, `.github` or dependency is touched. The empty-document line is unchanged at `bottom-56`, still about 3 px above the bar's top.

### Local results (head fdcfff5b trial-merged with origin/main 0757563d - clean, no conflicts)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | ok - 609 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| incl. `bar_fits_its_buttons`, `legend_clears_the_ribbon`, `the_hud_is_laid_out_from_the_pane_alone`, `the_nav_bar_drives_view_state` and the four `pick_through::*` tests | ok - 8/8 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- **Remaining overlap below about 453 px.** I do not count it as a blocker. The window opens at 1280x800 (`shell_window.rs:194`). It sets no minimum size, so a pane that narrow can only come from shrinking the window or dragging a split hard, and at that width the viewport is barely usable anyway. Even then only the hover-time legend's left end goes under the translucent bar; no control is hidden. The decision file records it, with the next step (lift the legend only when the two meet).
- The gate assertions now read `viewcube::min_width()` rather than literal pixel values. Together with `bar_fits_its_buttons`, which pins `BAR_W` from the button count, the numbers are still pinned, just one step removed. That is fine.
- `legend_clears_the_ribbon` measures with `egui::Style::default()`'s Small font. If a theme ever enlarges Small, the 453 px threshold moves up. The 700 px case still has about 250 px of slack.
- Nothing has been looked at on screen yet; the hand test should check the bar's contrast on the light background.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
